confidence.heading: How to Read the Confidence Labels
confidence.intro: Every rule and tax statement on this page carries a confidence label plus its source, date checked, jurisdiction, applicability and caveat.

legend.Source-backed: cited to an official government, customs or transport source URL.
legend.Needs verification: not yet confirmed against a current official source; verify before trading.
legend.Estimated: an estimate or a figure that changes frequently.
legend.Confirmed: independently verified against an official document. No statement on this page currently meets this bar.

vehicle.title: {model} to {country} — export compatibility & cost
vehicle.description: Exporting the {model} ({zh}) to {country}: drive-side fit, age-rule fit, EV charging compatibility, import requirements and duty anchors — each statement with source, confidence and date checked.
vehicle.disclaimer: This information is provided for general guidance only and is not legal advice. Every assertion below carries a source and confidence level — verify with official authorities before trading.

decision.driveMatch: Left-hand-drive match — a China-market unit can be registered without conversion.
decision.driveConversion: Right-hand-drive version is available — source the RHD unit rather than converting a China LHD unit.
decision.driveMismatch: Drive-side mismatch — a China-market LHD unit cannot be registered as-is in this RHD market.
decision.ageEligible: Age-rule fit — current-generation units satisfy the destination age limit.
decision.ageBorderline: Age-rule borderline — early production units sit near or over the age cut-off; verify the exact date.
decision.ageIneligible: Age-rule ineligible — the model's production window predates the destination age cut-off.
decision.evDutyRelief: EV duty relief — the electric trim qualifies for a reduced or zero import-duty rate.
decision.chargingMismatch: Charging connector mismatch — a GB/T-to-destination adapter is required and should be confirmed.

risks.duty: Duty / VAT rates change frequently — verify current figures with official customs before trading.
risks.age: Age-limit rules may be adjusted — confirm the current cut-off before sourcing stock.
risks.conformity: Conformity / certification requirements may change — confirm before shipment.
risks.charging: Charging-connector compatibility must be confirmed against the destination network.

checklist.age: Confirm the unit's production / registration date is within the destination age limit.
checklist.rhd: Confirm right-hand-drive availability with the exporter before purchase.
checklist.adapter: Confirm charging-adapter availability for the destination connector standard.
